rows.name: LAB_NIX_CACHE

problems.statement: The jobs on the FPGA runners fetch the build plan (the Nix recipe and inputs of the Tron build) from this cache. They also fetch the prebuilt test and benchmark builds of Tron from it.
problems.code_says: Only job `tron-build` fetches the build plan. `tron-build` builds the test and benchmark builds and does not fetch them. Jobs `test-host`, `test-fpga`, `benchmark` (gcp-nix.yml) and `refresh` (bench-refresh.yml) fetch only the prebuilt builds.

No script checks the URL. `acquire` repeats a failed `nix copy` until its time limit and then raises an error: 2700 seconds by default in `acquire.py` and `wait.py`, 900 seconds in `test_runtime.py` and `benchmark_runtime.py`.

cells.Read by: Steps of the jobs `wait-for-lab-cache`, `tron-build`, `test-host`, `test-fpga` and `benchmark` (`.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml`) and of the job `refresh` (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml`).
cells.Values and default: URL of a Nix binary cache (a server that holds finished Nix build results). Both workflows write `http://nix-store.positron.internal:5000`. Unset: does not occur. Both workflows define it.
cells.Effect: The job `tron-build` fetches the build plan (the Nix recipe and inputs of the Tron build) from this cache. Before that, the job `wait-for-lab-cache` waits until the cache holds the complete plan. The test, benchmark and refresh jobs fetch the prebuilt test and benchmark builds of Tron from it. The steps pass the URL as the option `--cache` or `--lab-cache` to `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py` and other scripts. With a wrong URL, a step fails only when its wait time ends.
